categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the manufacturing and sales of Western medicines, health supplements, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Additional business segments include medical devices, veterinary drugs, cosmetics, and milk powder. The company also engages in research and development of new drug formulations and health products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes chemical synthesis and biotechnology fermentation technologies for API production. It employs advanced pharmaceutical formulation techniques including sustained-release, laser-drilled sustained-release, and orally disintegrating tablets. Manufacturing processes comply with international GMP standards, and the company integrates upstream API synthesis with downstream drug formulation and packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and healthcare providers primarily in Taiwan. The company also targets international markets including the US, Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, and other Asian countries. The product portfolio serves therapeutic areas such as central nervous system, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, metabolic, urinary, and respiratory diseases, as well as health supplements for general wellness.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with domestic sales supported by regional offices. Internationally, it has subsidiaries and sales offices in China (Shanghai), the Philippines, Vietnam, and other Southeast Asian countries. It actively exports to over 67 countries, including major markets like the US, Japan, China, Europe, and emerging markets in Asia and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is vertically integrated, covering upstream API synthesis, midstream pharmaceutical formulation, and downstream sales and marketing. It controls raw material supply through subsidiaries and investments in API manufacturing, ensuring stable supply for its formulation plants. The company also acts as an agent for original brand drugs in Taiwan.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding R&D investment focusing on niche and differentiated generic drugs, developing new drug delivery systems and special formulations, and accelerating international market expansion. The company emphasizes innovation in sustained-release and rapid-dissolving formulations, leveraging AI tools to optimize operations. It also pursues international regulatory approvals and partnerships to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, health supplements, and APIs. The company also earns income from contract manufacturing and licensing agreements. Sales channels include direct sales to healthcare institutions, pharmacies, and distributors domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international pharmaceutical manufacturers, including multinational original drug companies and local generic drug producers. It positions itself as a vertically integrated, quality-focused pharmaceutical manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities and international certifications, aiming to differentiate through niche products and international market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.79 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing an 8.8% growth over the prior year. Net profit increased by 11.8% to about NT$1.29 billion, with earnings per share of NT$4.93. The company maintains a robust asset base exceeding NT$11 billion and equity of about NT$9 billion, showing steady growth and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical products with unique formulations such as laser-drilled sustained-release and orally disintegrating tablets to improve patient compliance. It leverages vertical integration for supply stability and cost control, and holds multiple international certifications (FDA, PIC/S GMP, ISO standards) to assure product quality. Its global regulatory approvals and strategic international partnerships enhance its competitive edge.
